Answer: E) The endobronchial valve placement sealed the bronchopleural fistula.  
Reason: Figure 2 shows extensive subcutaneous emphysema (radiolucent streaks in soft tissues of neck and chest wall), while Figure 6 shows marked reduction of this air; additionally, Figure 6 clearly depicts an endobronchial valve device (coiled wire-like structure in right main bronchus) not present in Figure 2—this intervention is the only plausible mechanism among the options that directly addresses the source (bronchopleural fistula) and explains the observed improvement.
